Private configuration values were not read/exported by reviewer and do not occur in public artifacts. Equality was attested by existing controller path, not independently rechecked.
No fresh SDK/import/callable/startup, source-policy, effective-config, endpoint health, namespace, DB lineage, volume-byte or citation proof. Runtime remains INCOMPLETE.
Preparation label is consumed; cutover marker was absent at read-only existence check, not atomically reserved or guaranteed unused later. No reset/retry/adoption of old stages authorized.

Controller budget 300 seconds includes 120 recovery reserve; review does not independently measure execution duration or attest global wall-clock guarantees. Persistent build/cache/config/log effects and cleanup limits remain disclosed.
Any later packet must bind these new actual IDs, current guard and applicable source/policy evidence and retain all mandatory fresh fail-closed checks. No startup/cutover/query permission follows.
